regions._note: The sheet's own left-edge scale-anchor figure (standing, not seated) reused as the idle pose -- honest flag carried from t-59: no sheet in the current set shows the character genuinely idle AT the desk without typing (PROMPTS.md kit item 28, 'seated idle', is still open). Same figure that anchors this manifest's pitch.
regions._phase_note: FACE-LEGIBILITY FIX (t-141 round 3, moneta's binding-gate send-back): auto best_phase picked (1,1), which collapsed the brow+eye band into one flat dark cell -- the sprite read as a peach smear with a dark bar, not the sheet face, failing the mission's automatic-send-back face gate. Root cause is structural, not a bug: best_phase maximizes intra-cell color agreement, and for a face whose features are each thinner than one 7.4px cell, the highest-agreement phase is the one that AVERAGES two features into a single uniform (smeared) cell -- the metric rewards exactly the smear the gate forbids. Swept all 64 integer phase offsets and rendered the head at each at 26x against the cited source region (24,22,150,115 head band): (5,3) is the offset that lands cell rows on the brow / eye / nose / mouth bands -- a localized dark near-eye (the source is a 3/4 view with one prominent eye), brow, nose ridge with highlight, a red mouth, jaw, undercut hair, matching the source's rightward gaze. An independent inner-critic pass confirmed it clears the recognizability gate (identity carried by face features, not just hair/collar), versus the auto (1,1) which read as a hollow dark bar. Pinned here as a manual phase (the tool's sanctioned override, same class as anchor_source_px_height); the other four agent frames keep auto best_phase and are byte-identical. Deterministic: fixed phase -> byte-identical re-run.

_comment: Region coordinates, key_tolerance, and edge_hue_tolerance (default) reused verbatim from t-59-office-sample-scene's round-27 committed manifest (hub/public/office-sample-assets/rectify-manifests/manifest-typing4.json, commit 3071ab5) -- those citations were independently re-verified for determinism by two separate critic passes across rounds 24-27 (byte-identical re-runs, zero key-adjacent pixels, zero magenta-hue edge residue), confirmed byte-identical again in this manifest's own report. ONE deliberate deviation from the inherited manifest: palette_size raised from 28 to 80. THE PALETTE LAW fix (t-141 mission body): with palette_size=28, build_shared_palette's frequency-sorted greedy bucketing filled its entire budget with dark blue/navy jacket-hair-background shades before ever reaching a skin-toned bucket -- diagnosed directly by dumping the group's full ranked bucket list (5550 opaque votes, 357 buckets after quantization): the largest genuine skin cluster (218,137,118), 16 votes) doesn't rank until position 58, and NONE of the 28 buckets that made the old cutoff carry r>b+10 (a skin-hue heuristic). Every skin pixel was therefore forced by snap_to_palette onto the nearest dark-blue entry -- this IS the blue-face defect, reproduced and root-caused directly in this manifest's own agent group despite the group already being subject-isolated (no cross-subject mixing) per the existing per-subject grouping t-59 already had; the defect's actual mechanism is budget truncation within an already-correctly-scoped single-subject palette, not cross-subject contamination as such. The existing accent-color exemption doesn't rescue this: skin's own saturation (~0.46 for the lead skin bucket) sits just under accent_saturation_min's 0.5 threshold, and accent_max_area_frac is intentionally 0 per the t-59 round-25 fix (re-enabling it risks re-admitting JPEG-ringing noise, the exact bug that fix closed). Raising palette_size instead is a strictly frequency-budget fix, not a special-case: tested empirically (28->0 skin entries in the resulting palette, 40->1, 48->2, 64->3, 80->7), 80 was chosen as the first tested size giving a real gradient of skin shades (shadow through highlight) rather than a single flat tone, while still leaving the great majority of the budget (73 of 80 entries) for the jacket/hair/background material ramps that dominate the sprite's actual pixel area. Verified below (see the mission log / review note): the shipped idle-0 and typing-* sprites now carry visibly warm, skin-toned face pixels at matched-zoom side-by-side against the source. Sheet path is relative to projects/bureau/references/office/ in the brain (GET /api/knowledge?file=projects/bureau/references/office/<sheet>&raw=1).
